thread:
lucy-partnerships: Heads-up: joint dry-run with Databricks + Qdrant tomorrow. We need a coordinated checklist: connector creds, marketplace listing preview, and one co-branded demo script that shows search + rerank. Can we run a smoke flow that touches Snowflake too?

omar-eng: I can spin up connectors in partner-sandbox and a staging notebook on Databricks. What Snowflake account shall we use for the sample data?

lucy-partnerships: Use snow-demo-eu (tenant: redwood-snow-eu). Keep schema read-only for the connector user.

sophia-soleng: Our demo script will: 1) load sample sales transcripts to Snowflake stage, 2) run a transform to clean text, 3) call Redwood embeddings + index to Qdrant, 4) run a semantic search and then rerank using Redwood's reranker. Need to ensure Databricks can read the Qdrant endpoint for benching.

dan-dbricks: We'll expose a temporary cluster and a tiny DBFS notebook with the bench code. Share the Qdrant URL and token. Also confirm CORS and IP allowlist.

omar-eng: Will create service account svc_partner_co_demo with labels partner=databricks-qdrant and test=marketplace-dryrun. I'll attach a route policy with fallback_model=redwood-small and burst limits.

lucy-partnerships: Marketplace preview notes: legal wants the listing copy by EOD today. Marketing to include 'Redwood + Databricks + Qdrant connector: single-click vector ingest from Lakehouse' as a short blurb. Keep feature bullets focused on secure transfer, role-based access, and low-latency inferencing.

sophia-soleng: Add a telemetry tag run_id=mkp_dryrun_2024_06 so we can correlate costs. Also, we'll need per-route token-level cost breakdown in the console for the demo.

omar-eng: Done. I provisioned svc_partner_co_demo, posted the Qdrant token in secure channel, and set IP allowlist for the Databricks cluster. Sync-bot: deployment scheduled at 2024-06-19T16:00:00Z.

dan-dbricks: Can you also add a tiny sample Delta table with 500 rows so we can show COPY/INTO and streaming ingest?

lucy-partnerships: Yes, will upload the sample CSV to the Snowflake stage and share the copy command.

omar-eng: Sample copy command: ```sql
COPY INTO sales_stage.table_demo FROM @redwood_demo_stage/sales_sample.csv FILE_FORMAT=(TYPE=CSV FIELD_OPTIONALLY_ENCLOSED_BY='\"');
```

sophia-soleng: Running a quick smoke: embeddings call succeeded, qdrant ingest ok, initial search latency ~85ms. I'll run the full bench post-dry-run.

lucy-partnerships: Thanks all. Legal will review marketplace copy and circle back. Please flag any blockers in the thread.

sync-bot: Dry-run completed successfully (run id: dryrun-9844). Metrics: avg lat=92ms, peak rps=1500, fallback hit rate=3%.

dan-dbricks: Notebook link: https://databricks.com/workspace/redwood/partner-demo (view only).

lucy-partnerships: Closing out for now. We'll iterate on copy after legal feedback. :sparkles:
